response.title: Staff Seek FY2027 Budget for a Sixth Site at Eastgate
response.dek: Staff want the board to approve a $1,610,000 FY2027 budget that adds a sixth site and two site coordinators to cut a growing waitlist.

stat.label: Adults still on the waitlist at the end of FY2026

sections.heading: The request
sections.body: Staff recommend a budget of $1,610,000 for FY2027. The money would open a sixth site at the Eastgate branch library and hire two site coordinators. Staff estimate the new site would serve 180 more learners a year. They expect it to cut the waitlist in half.

sections.heading: More adults want help
sections.body: Harborlight enrolled 1,148 adult learners in FY2026. The year before, it enrolled 936. At year end, 287 adults were still waiting for a spot, mostly at the Eastgate and Riverside sites. On average, they waited nine weeks.

sections.heading: Results from FY2026
sections.body: Sixty-eight percent of learners who stayed at least 12 weeks gained one or more reading levels. Seventy-one learners earned a high school equivalency credential. That is the most in Harborlight's history. A group of 214 volunteer tutors gave 9,870 hours of tutoring.

sections.heading: Where the money stands
sections.body: Operating expenses in FY2026 were $1,420,000, and 81 percent of spending went to programs. Foundation grants brought in $640,000, individual donors $388,000, and the city contract $295,000. Reserves cover 3.2 months of operating expenses. The board's target is 4 months.

points.text: 412 learners worked toward a high school equivalency credential
Harborlight has 11 full-time staff, four of them site coordinators

quote.text: I read my granddaughter a bedtime story for the first time this spring.
quote.who: A learner at the Riverside site

response.next: The board votes on the FY2027 budget at its October 21 meeting.
